# 🛡️ Security Policy — GLASTOR® Byte-Gauge

## Supported Versions

| Version | Supported          |
| ------- | ------------------ |
| 0.1.x   | :white_check_mark: |

## Reporting a Vulnerability

Please report security vulnerabilities privately to **GLASTOR® Core Security** at:

- **Email:** [ventas@glastor.es](mailto:ventas@glastor.es)
- **GitHub Security Advisories:** [https://github.com/glastor-core/byte-gauge/security/advisories/new](https://github.com/glastor-core/byte-gauge/security/advisories/new)

We follow a strict **Zero-Trust & Shift-Left DevSecOps** response protocol across the [`glastor-core`](https://github.com/glastor-core) ecosystem ([`vortex`](https://github.com/glastor-core/vortex), [`medusa`](https://github.com/glastor-core/medusa), [`nemesis`](https://github.com/glastor-core/nemesis), and `byte-gauge`).
